responsibility: Implements the procedural backend for the Xstormy16 target by supplying the target hook functions and helper routines referenced by stormy16.h and stormy16.md. This file owns Stormy16-specific RTL expansion and late backend behavior such as custom compare/branch emission for HImode and SImode conditions, reload/postreload and machine-dependent reorg cleanups, operand/address and move-cost modeling, calling-convention decisions including argument/return handling and varargs support, register/mode legality checks, builtin expansion, trampoline and thunk assembly support, section/constructor handling, and target-specific operand/address printing and encoding. In effect it is the executable logic that turns generic GCC backend operations into Stormy16 ABI, addressing, and instruction-sequence behavior, while wiring those routines into targetm through TARGET_* hook definitions.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable C backend for the Stormy16 port: it implements and registers TARGET_* hooks, expanders, reorg, cost models, calling-convention helpers, builtins, and assembler callbacks that the rest of the port relies on. Unlike stormy16.h, it does not define the target’s static machine-description macros; unlike stormy16.md, it is not the declarative RTL pattern file; unlike stormy16.opt, it does not declare command-line target options.
